name: terminal
need: Frame a terminal emulator: title, connection status, actions, and the keys a phone keyboard lacks

--ds-terminal-height.description: terminal frame: the height of the screen (not with `--fill`)

--ds-terminal-bg.description: terminal frame: the ground of the screen, and the emulator's background (`DS.terminal.theme`)

--ds-terminal-fg.description: terminal frame: the text of the screen, and the emulator's foreground

--ds-terminal-cursor.description: terminal frame: the caret and the emulator's cursor

--ds-terminal-selection.description: terminal frame: selected text on the screen

--ds-terminal-radius.description: terminal frame: the frame's corners at the default shape

--ds-terminal-font.description: terminal frame: the title and plain output on the screen

--ds-terminal-black.description: terminal frame: ANSI black (and bright black)

labExempt.DS.terminal.create: the frame does not move: the status chip glides by .ds-status and the keys press as buttons
